questions.stem: A 2 year old child with large untreated boil on right thigh, comes in septic shock. He is started on IV fluids & after giving 3 NS boluses, he develops basal crepitations but the shock continues. He is also administered a dose of Hydrocortisone & started on Dopamine infusion. Currently he is on Dopamine infusion @ 20 micrograms/kg/min. What is the next therapy to consider?
